purpose: Bound false discovery across the open-ended sequence requested on 2026-09-01. This policy cannot be changed, replaced, or reset after any cycle outcome.
cycle_numbering: The first mechanism selected after this file is cycle k=1. Every selected mechanism consumes its ordinal even if data are unavailable, integrity aborts, or the minimum sample is missed. Alpha is never recycled.

global_multiplicity.rule: Every inferential p-value gate in both the primary and replication windows must be strictly below that cycle's alpha_k. A primary pass is necessary before replication, and a survivor requires every conjunctive effect, consistency, sample, integrity, and p-value gate to pass in both windows. No disjunctive endpoints, best-of variants, or post-hoc subsets are allowed.
global_multiplicity.guarantee_boundary: Because entry to replication requires a primary p-value below alpha_k and the primary tests are alpha-spent across cycles, the probability that any true-null mechanism enters replication is bounded by 0.05 under valid per-cycle tests, without assuming independence across cycles. Replication is additional evidence, not a reason to relax the primary threshold.

historical_data_boundary: Every historical calendar is treated as consumed. Contracts may claim only rule-level, information-channel, or transformation novelty, never a fresh, untouched, blind, or prospective sample. Append-only observations after their recorded collection start are the only prospective data.
survival_boundary: Survival means one immutable campaign passes its primary and preregistered replication windows with identical frozen code and all gates, then closes FROZEN-CERTIFIED. It does not imply tradable alpha, causality, deployment readiness, capital allocation, or a breakthrough.
stopping_boundary: A negative or inconclusive campaign is published and closed before the next ordinal is selected. Closed families are never tuned, pooled, extended, re-windowed, or revived.
